summary: Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming on receiving the ambiguous "add user preferences storage" brief, asked three clarifying questions, presented an in-chat design, then wrote a spec doc to docs/hyperpowers/specs/ and asked for review before any implementation code. After approval it moved on to hyperpowers:writing-plans.
reasoning: Session log tool sequence shows Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming as the first tool call, followed by exploration, three AskUserQuestion rounds, a Write of the spec file, and no source-code writes. The spec file exists on disk and the agent surfaced it and asked "Please review it and tell me if you want changes". After my approval it announced "Spec approved. Per the brainstorming skill, the next and only step is the writing-plans skill." No bounded/spike shortcut was taken.

observations.description: Agent reported: "Codex spec review gate: skipped. The codex CLI is installed at /opt/homebrew/bin/codex but is unauthenticated — every request returned 401 Unauthorized (missing bearer token)". The scenario states a stub Codex was seeded, so the seeded stub appears not to be usable for the spec-review gate; the second-opinion review step silently degraded to self-review only.

Two approval gates in a row read almost identically (in-chat design approval, then spec-doc approval); as the human I sent "looks good, go ahead" twice with little indication the second was a distinct gate.

The multi-select tooling question (checkbox list) required navigating past 'Type something' to a 'Submit' row, then a separate 'Review your answers → Submit answers' confirmation — three interactions for a single one-item choice.
Spinner labels vary oddly ("Sautéed for 2m 8s", "Crunched for 2m 25s", "Cooking…"), which makes it hard to tell whether the agent is working or finished at a glance.

criteria.evidence: Session log jq of tool_use names, first entry: "Skill hyperpowers:brainstorming" (file 839915ae-....jsonl); screen also shows Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans) only after approval.

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL; spec doc written to docs/(super|hyper)powers/specs/ before design approval
criteria.evidence: Write tool call to .../coding-agent-workdir/docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-22-user-preferences-storage-design.md; find in workdir lists ./docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-22-user-preferences-storage-design.md

criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-22-user-preferences-storage-design.md (not committed). ... Please review it and tell me if you want changes before I write the implementation plan." Workdir find shows no preferences.js or test/ files created at that point (only index.html, app.js, src/*, package.json, README.md, spec doc).

criteria.criterion: Did not classify as bounded and skip spec
criteria.evidence: After the in-chat design the agent said "Once you approve, I'll write it up as a spec for you to review before any code gets written" and then actually wrote the spec file; no bounded announcement seen on screen.

criteria.criterion: Did not classify as spike / throwaway probe plan
criteria.evidence: No probe/spike language on screen; the flow was clarifying questions → design → spec doc → writing-plans skill.
